'''Toranial Mishulas''' is a high elf located in [[Brinthilien]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]].

==Notes==
* Although his title says that he is an "apprentice weapon master", he can't teach any weapons to players.

==Patch changes==
* {{Patch|1.17.1|note=Moved from [[Farstrider Lodge]] in [[Loch Modan]] to the new high elf starting zone at [[Brinthilien]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]].}}
